profile_text.body:
UiPath is a publicly traded enterprise software company (NYSE: PATH, CIK 0001734722) that describes itself as providing a platform for business orchestration and automation. Its core offering, the UiPath Platform, is positioned around combining AI agents, robotic process automation, and human workers on a single system, with the company emphasizing governance, compliance, and measurable outcomes as central design goals rather than optional features.

The company's primary AI product, tracked here as UiPath AI, spans robotic process automation, document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance. The platform also includes purpose-built agentic solutions intended to orchestrate critical business workflows without requiring organizations to replace existing systems, as well as tools that bring agentic AI into software testing, covering design, automation, execution, and orchestration of testing pipelines.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filing details beyond the basic public-company registration are present in the current held facts.
